# Arnav Goel

Arnav Goel is a Computer Science undergraduate at the National University of Singapore, graduating in May 2027. He works across product thinking, applied AI, spatial computing, accessibility, and software engineering, with a focus on building thoughtful products from 0 to 1 and technology for good.

## Canonical pages

- [Portfolio](https://arnav-goel.com/): Selected work, project summaries, implementation details, and outcomes.
- [About](https://arnav-goel.com/about): Experience, skills, education context, and contact links.
- [Resume](https://arnav-goel.com/arnav-goel-resume.pdf): Downloadable PDF resume.

## Selected work

- Amble: A public 3D discovery platform serving 100+ monthly users, bringing Singapore events, restaurants, live promotions, and day planning into one spatial experience.
- SupplyCue: A stateful AI procurement platform that reduced manual coordination per order from about 90 to 15 minutes by connecting Telegram requests, supplier negotiation, and invoice verification.
- LiveShield: A native Android live streaming app that masks faces, QR codes, private text, and custom regions on device before any frame reaches social platforms.
- On-Device Low Vision Assistant: An on device iPhone assistant designed to help people with low vision independently identify Singapore currency and complete appliance tasks with private, step by step voice guidance.
- TRIBE v2 Music Optimization: A model guided music production pipeline that remixed a hip hop track toward sleep alignment and improved its target score by +0.711.
- Vision Pro Hand Dexterity Assessment: A Vision Pro and iPad hand assessment, refined with 7 patients, that turns movement into quantified 3D metrics for tracking stroke recovery.
- ByteStreak: A native Android widget that keeps the LeetCode Daily Challenge visible through 12 responsive mascot states and completion-aware reminders.
